entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I hope you can help me. I need to talk about an order I placed a little while ago.
Of course. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this and I've been a loyal customer for years.
I appreciate your loyalty, and I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see the ClubFit Jersey. What's going on with it?
It's the jersey. I finally had a chance to wear it, and it's the wrong size. It's just way too tight across the shoulders. I was so excited for it, and now I just feel... deflated.
I understand completely. Getting the sizing right is crucial, and it's frustrating when it's not perfect. So you were hoping to exchange it or return it?
Well, I was thinking about an exchange, but to be honest, I could really use the money back right now. Is it too late for a return? I feel terrible asking.
Not at all, let's take a look. I see you received the jersey about 72 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you.
Okay, good news. That item falls under our 90-day return window. You're well within the timeframe, so I can definitely process a full refund for you. No problem at all.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much, Isaac. You have no idea what a help that is.

You are very welcome. I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for being so understanding.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
